notes.title: J-Tech Studio Joins the Jazzoid Family
notes.content:
[p]Greetings survivors,[/p][p][/p][p]We’re here today not with a gameplay patch, but with something just as meaningful: a change of identity — and a reaffirmation of purpose.[/p][p][/p][p]After years of haunting screens and stirring hearts with our first title, [b]J-Tech Studios has been officially incorporated into Jazzoid Studios[/b]. This new name carries not only a vision for the future, but also a deep respect for the work that came before it.[/p][p][/p][p]You may have noticed new artwork, refreshed descriptions, and a few visual updates on the store page. But no, this isn’t the beginning of something entirely new — it’s the [b]preservation of a legacy[/b], carried forward under a new banner.[/p][p][/p][p]We know the game hasn’t received many updates lately, and for that, we’ve remained quiet. Life happens. Time passes. But the fire never fully went out.
[b]This project has always lived in the shadows, and perhaps that’s where it belongs — but it still lives.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]To everyone who stood by this nightmare — from the early days of [i]Pesadelo: Início[/i] to now — thank you for carrying this world with you.[/p][p][/p][p][b]What’s changed:[/b][/p][list][*][p]J-Tech Studios has been fully incorporated into [b]Jazzoid Studios[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Updated store assets and descriptions to reflect the new identity[/p][/*][*][p]Minor polish across the page, with more consistency in tone and presentation[/p][/*][/list][p]There are no promises here. Only the recognition that this story — and this world — are far from forgotten.[/p][p][/p][p]Also, as a great defender of "Stop Killing Games", this game despite of the low marketing and low sales, for those who ever bought, it won't be remove, in fact, it could receive a few updates in the future, who knows.[/p][p][/p][p]Keep your flashlight close.[/p][p][/p][p]— Jazzoid Team[/p]

notes.title: Challenge Accepted: Climb the Global Leaderboard!
notes.content:
When you slay creatures in our game, your kill count is tracked. If you die, the score resets, but while you're alive, your achievements are added to the global leaderboard.

To see where you stand, visit the Steam community hub. In the upper right corner, click "View Stats" -> "Global Leaderboards" to check out the top kill sprees.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43316392/d51d6a03a8046bec6e7c7c6f3662606cff2474bd.png[/img]

Who will claim the top spot? Will it be you?

notes.title: Patch Notes - Adding support for Inventory Service and more
notes.content:
[h2]New Features[/h2]

Inventory Service Integration: We've added full support for the Inventory Service. This major update brings new ways for players to acquire and customize items.
Mystery Box and Item Drop: Players can now find Mystery Boxes in-game. Fix these boxes to trigger an Item Drop, which will reward players with items to visually customize their guns.
Item Market: Items received from drops or purchased in the market can be used to customize weapons, but players must first unlock the corresponding gun in the game.

[h2]Improvements[/h2]
Input System Overhaul: The input system has been updated to improve controller support and address various bugs. Expect a smoother and more responsive gameplay experience.
Core System Update: The game's core has been updated to align with the latest security updates for both the OS and the game engine. This ensures a more secure and stable gaming environment.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
Weapon Interaction Fix: Resolved an issue where weapons would fire automatically during FPS drops. This fix ensures more reliable weapon behavior under all conditions.
Minor Bug Fixes: Addressed several minor bugs to improve overall game stability and performance.

Thank you for your continued support and feedback. Enjoy the new features and improvements in Midnight Alert!

notes.title: Build 1.2.1: A Minor Update with Critical Improvements
notes.content:
We are excited to announce the release of Build 1.2.1, a minor update that brings a number of critical improvements to our game.

In this update, we have addressed a bug related to dialogue that was preventing players from returning to the previous screen. This should provide a more seamless experience for our players.

We have also added a new flag that will cancel the dialogue if the player receives any hit. This will allow players to focus on the action and not miss any important information

We have also fixed an issue with the Rifle Scope that was preventing players from seeing long distances. This should improve the overall gameplay experience for our players.

We have also optimized the AI to prevent issues with the pathfinder when the user decides to jump on a table. This should provide a more fair and enjoyable experience for all players.

We understand that even minor updates can have a big impact on the game. We are committed to providing the best experience possible for our players, and we appreciate your continued support and feedback.

We hope you enjoy these new improvements and features. As always, please continue to share your feedback and suggestions with us so that we can continue to improve the game.

notes.title: Build 1.2.0: A Major Update on UI, Gameplay, Scenario and a lot of improvements
notes.content:
We are excited to announce the release of Build 1.2.0, a major update to our game that brings a number of improvements and new features to enhance your gameplay experience.

In this update, we have fixed a bug related to the UI that was causing some strange behavior when pausing the game while interacting with computers or open dialogues. This should provide a smoother and more seamless experience for our players.

We have also updated the levels to prevent players from exploiting a glitch that allowed them to jump off the scenario. This should provide a more fair and enjoyable experience for all players.

We have added a new hit mark feature, which will make it easier for players to see when they have successfully hit an enemy.

We have also added some UI improvements related to healing, which will make it easier for players to keep track of their health and manage their healing items.

Finally, we are excited to introduce a new creature that players will encounter during gameplay. This new creature will add an additional layer of challenge and excitement to the game.

We hope you enjoy these new improvements and features. As always, please continue to share your feedback and suggestions with us so that we can continue to improve the game.
